**prismatic-flipperzero** is a project in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md). Its code is written mainly in [C](@/glossary/c.md) (46.8 %), with [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) and [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 25 November 2026; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 25 November 2026. It reads “feat(calculate): one stepper adds a source; the calculator fits one screen”. That places it among the projects active in the last 12 months.

It runs as a live site on [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md): <https://korczis.github.io/prismatic-flipperzero/>.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/prismatic-flipperzero).
